caveats: Phase unions merge variants and rounds for required-evidence coverage only; they are not rankings for Precision/MRR/nDCG.
Mapped-source union includes successful direct source prompts, including group summaries and repairs; it does not map a synthesis summary back to source pages.
Last context means the last recorded generation attempt, not proof that its draft became the final answer. Missing/failed/unmapped final context remains N/A.
Required evidence uses exact frozen anchors or reviewed span-identity labels. Cropping creates a new span identity; lower coverage need not imply semantic loss.
HTTP counts include every recorded attempt, including retries. Unknown usage is excluded from known sums and invalidates complete totals. No price estimate is made.
